dct_description_sm:
Electrical Manholes are used as an access point for maintenance and other work on electrical infrastructure. Electrical Manhole data are edited as needed by City of Victoria Electrical Staff, and copied to the Open Data portal nightly.

The "Last Updated" date shown on our Open Data Portal refers to the last time the data schema was modified in the portal, or any changes were made to this description.  We update our data through weekly or daily scripts which does not trigger the "last updated" date to change.

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
schema_provider_s: City of Victoria Open Data Portal
